title: Service catalog entry
description: One service in the resident service catalog. One YAML file per service under backend/app/data/services/. Cross-file rules (unique id/slug, category references, location service_id) are enforced by backend/scripts/validate_catalog.py, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the service (for example svc-age). Never reuse or change once published.

slug.description: URL-safe unique name, lowercase words joined by hyphens. Must match the file name.

name.description: Public name of the service or program.

description.description: Plain-language summary of what the service provides.

eligibility_summary.description: Plain-language statement of who qualifies. Required so residents are never shown a service without knowing who it is for.

eligibility_requires.description: Hard eligibility gates the matching engine checks against the resident profile. All listed gates must be satisfied.

how_to_apply.description: Steps a resident takes to get the service.

cost.description: Plain-language description of cost to the resident.

website_url.description: Public web page for the service. May be empty if none exists (validator warns).

phone.description: Main contact phone. A service must have this or at least one location phone.

languages_offered.description: Language codes the service can be delivered in (for example en, es).

accessibility_features.description: Accessibility features, for example Wheelchair accessible.

status.description: Whether the service is currently offered.

categories.description: Category slugs (the slug field in categories.yaml, for example healthcare). At least one. Validity against categories.yaml is checked by the validator.

locations.description: Physical sites. May be empty for phone-only or online-only services.

documents.description: Documents a resident should bring or submit.

last_verified_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) a person last confirmed this entry against the provider. Optional; absent means unverified.

verified_by.description: Name or role of the person who last verified this entry. Optional; absent means unverified.

is_required.description: True if the document is mandatory.

service_id.description: Must equal the parent service id (checked by the validator).

name.description: Site name, for example Main Campus.

zip_code.description: ZIP code as a quoted string.

hours.description: Opening hours keyed by lowercase day name; values are display strings such as 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM or Closed.

hours_verified.description: True only if a person confirmed these hours with the provider.
